question.text: Under PMLA 2002, the PM must report suspicious transactions to FIU-IND within:

explanation.text: The Logic: Under the PMLA/FIU-IND reporting requirement, the portfolio manager must report any suspicious transaction within 7 working days to FIU-IND. The Trap: 24 hours is too tight and 30 days is too lax; the prescribed timeline is 7 working days. Note: The suspicious transaction reporting (STR) obligation flows from PMLA and is reiterated in the PMS workbook's PMLA discussion.
